The Club

Built on Community.
Playing for Ambition.

Kiyinda Boys FC is a community-rooted football club competing in the FUFA Big League — Uganda's second tier of professional football. Founded with the belief that local talent, discipline and collective ambition can compete at the highest level, the club represents not just a team but a standard for Kiyinda and the surrounding communities.

In the 2026/27 season, Kiyinda Boys FC are making their mark in Group A, combining youthful energy with experienced leadership to build a squad capable of challenging for promotion.
